author: Angela Latimer
title: Cream Cheese Rotisserie Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 lbs rotisserie chicken meat (shredded, or about 4 cups leftover pulled chicken)
8 oz cream cheese (softened, at room temperature)
¼ cup sour cream (or plain Greek yogurt)
10 oz RoTel diced tomatoes with green chilies (drained)
1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded, divided - or use fiesta blend shredded cheese)
instructions_list: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C/Gas Mark 4) and lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish. Spread a ½ cup of enchilada sauce across the bottom of the pan in a thin layer.
Shred the 2 lbs rotisserie chicken meat . In a large bowl, blend the softened 8 oz cream cheese , ¼ cup sour cream , and 1½ tsp taco seasoning until smooth and combined.

Stir in the shredded rotisserie chicken, drained 10 oz RoTel diced tomatoes with green chilies , and the first half of the shredded 1 cup pepper jack cheese and 1 cup 1 cup cheddar cheese then mix until the chicken is well coated.
Spoon the chicken mixture down the center of each of the 8 8-inch flour tortillas . Roll them tightly and place them seam-side down in the prepared baking dish.
Pour the remaining 28 oz red enchilada sauce over the assembled enchiladas and sprinkle with the rest of the shredded cheese.
Bake until the sauce is hot and bubbling and the cheese has completely melted. For a golden finish, broil for a few minutes at the end.
Remove from the oven, serve immediately garnished with fresh 1 bunch cilantro , green onions, or parsley.
description: Indulge in these cream cheese rotisserie chicken enchiladas, featuring a rich, velvety filling and zesty RoTel for the ultimate easy, cheesy family dinner! They’re a decadent, 40-minute meal that turns simple leftover chicken into restaurant-quality comfort.1x recipe yields 8 servings (1 enchilada per serving).
